title: Registered Nurse
description:
Join our healthcare facility as a Registered Nurse. Key Responsibilities:
- Provide high-quality patient care and monitor patient conditions.
- Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians.
- Educate patients and their families on health management.
- Maintain accurate and detailed patient records.
Requirements:
- Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred.
- Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license.
- BLS and ACLS certifications.
- Compassionate, patient-focused approach to care.
